13e8ba8ed046fc9091257f931cd358c7e0b5623c.summary: A DataBreaches blog update (published 12 August 2025) on Telegram channels and forums linked to ShinyHunters. It reports that a leaking channel and two accounts were banned, that a $500,000 bounty in XMR was posted on BreachForums for information on Yukari, and that BreachForums went down after a claimed compromise by law enforcement. The blog says it cannot verify these claims.
